title: jrs-upgrade --json error document (spec §14 Phase 8, §18)
description: Emitted on standard output by any command that refuses or fails in --json mode; the process exit code equals error.exitCode.

class.description: Exception simple name, or the exit code category (UsageError, PrecheckFailed, SignatureFailed, RecoveryRequired, LockHeld, Unsupported, Cancelled).
